Exact and Approximate Enumeration of Admixed Arrays
===================================================

This website documents features of **zagar**, a software for efficiently enumerating admixed arrays subject to row and column constraints. Admixed arrays are discrete structures arising from analyses of genetically admixed populations, and are closely related to binary matrices.
